runtimeHost.background: K-12 MG1655 for curated resistance phenotypes

provenance.limitation: T4 DSM 4505 life-history evidence is measured against E. coli K-12 MG1655 DSM 18039 in the Nabergoj chemostat context. Petra v1 conservatively binds that host background only to the exact flagship ecoli-k12-mg1655@1.0.0 WT runtime identity. This does not establish T4 susceptibility for ciprofloxacin-resistance genotypes, other MG1655 content revisions, Bacillus, other taxa, or any genotype-specific receptor phenotype.
